maria_cs: Kickoff: MeridianHealth private deploy — VPC peering, IAM role assumption, customer-managed KMS, and audit logs. @devon_eng can you confirm any routing or SG constraints? Timeline: aim to finish POC by EOW.

devon_eng: On it. Need their VPC CIDRs + AWS account IDs. Any hard restrictions on cross-account IAM?

maria_cs: CIDRs: customer = 10.20.0.0/16, redwood-private = 10.10.0.0/16. Account IDs: 222233334444 (Meridian), 555566667777 (Redwood-Private). They prefer role assumption for our agents. KMS is customer-managed and they want audit export to their S3.

raj_infra: KMS OK as customer-managed. We'll need a KMS key policy granting our service role. Example snippet (they should paste into key policy):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"AllowRedwood","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::555566667777:role/redwood-inference-service"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```
Note: also ensure `kms:CreateGrant` if we use data key caching.

elie_pm: FYI — CS flagged renewal as moderate risk if onboarding slips past next invoice date (2026-02-01). Mitigation: two enablement sessions + early perf report to show throughput/latency.

maria_cs: Good point. I'll schedule two 1hr enablement calls: infra deep-dive and audit/KMS walkthrough. @raj_infra can you run an audit-log readiness checklist?

raj_infra: Audit checklist: CloudTrail enabled for all regions; S3 bucket `meridian-audit` with SSE-KMS; CloudWatch Logs export configured; delivery role `meridian-trail-delivery` created and trusted by CloudTrail. Commands we typically run: `aws cloudtrail create-trail --name meridian-trail --s3-bucket meridian-audit` and `aws s3api put-bucket-encryption --bucket meridian-audit --server-side-encryption-configuration ...`. Retention: 90d by default, customer may request 365d.

devon_eng: Networking notes: Create VPC peering request from `vpc-0a1b2c3d` -> `vpc-0f9e8d7c`. Add route on Redwood side: destination `10.20.0.0/16` -> peering `pcx-0abc123`. Security groups: allow inbound 443, 8443 from customer CIDR. Turn off source/dest check on NAT instances if present. If they have strict NACLs, we need to coordinate.

maria_cs: Customer asked their compliance team should have read access to audit S3 and CloudWatch. Recommend creating role `arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/meridian-audit-reader` and grant s3:GetObject, cloudwatch:Describe*, cloudtrail:LookupEvents. @auditor_bot can you produce a starter policy?

auditor_bot: Generated sample policy link (private): https://internal.gist/meridian-audit-policy. Excerpt: `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","cloudwatch:Describe*","cloudtrail:LookupEvents"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::meridian-audit/*"]}]}`

deploy-bot: Deployment checklist updated: peering request sent 2025-11-01T14:12Z, KMS policy awaiting customer edit, IAM role invitation pending acceptance. Status: ACTION_REQUIRED (peering-approval, kms-policy-provision).

maria_cs: Action items: (1) @raj_infra upload KMS policy template to workspace by EOD; (2) @devon_eng provision peering + route by tomorrow noon; (3) I'll book enablement sessions for Wed/Thu and send pre-reads. I'll also flag renewal tracker with contingency.

devon_eng: Provisioning peering now. ETA ~3 hours, will update thread with `pcx-*` id.

raj_infra: KMS policy template uploaded to workspace at `/shared/meridian/kms-policy.json`. Note for customer: add service principal `redwood-inference.amazonaws.com` and allow `kms:CreateGrant` if using grant-based caching.

maria_cs: Perfect — once peering & IAM accepted we'll run the infra runbook and a short smoke test (connect, token auth, KMS encrypt/decrypt). Closing loop once smoke passes. :thumbsup:
